Answer: C
Reason: Comparing Figure 1 and Figure 2 reveals that the extensive consolidation initially present in the left lung has significantly cleared, while new patchy consolidations have appeared in the right lung. This pattern of resolving infiltrates in one area accompanied by new infiltrates in another is characteristic of migratory pulmonary opacities, a hallmark finding of Cryptogenic Organizing Pneumonia (COP).
